programs.desc: A political satire set in a small town in Rajasthan, where the local government is on the verge of collapsing due to factors such as corruption and mismanagement.

programs.title: I, Me Aur Main
programs.desc: Aarush, Al and Tanmay, three womanisers get the shock of their life when they find a baby girl at their doorstep claiming to be the daughter of one of them. As they try to find her mother, they discover an unexplored side of their own personality.
